title: [Shopify] Fix missing shop currency mapping on order transactions
summary: Shop currency code mapping on Shopify order transactions was accidentally removed in a previous commit and is now restored to ensure the Currency field displays correctly on the Order Transactions page.
key_points: The amountSet.shopMoney.currencyCode mapping to the Currency field was missing after a presentment currency support commit
The field was being used without being populated, causing stale or empty currency values
The fix re-adds the mapping alongside presentmentMoney to match the pattern already correctly used in amountRoundingSet
Shopify GraphQL query already provided the data; it just needed to be read and mapped
A test codeunit was added to verify the fix
